title: Tsutomu Yamaguchi — the man who survived BOTH atomic bombs
voiceover: On August 6th, 1945, a Japanese engineer named Tsutomu Yamaguchi was finishing a business trip in Hiroshima when the first atomic bomb dropped. He was less than two miles from the blast. He survived. Burned, deafened in one ear, but alive. The next day, he took a train home to recover. Home was Nagasaki. Three days later, he was at work, telling his boss what had happened in Hiroshima, when the sky lit up again. And he survived that too. He lived to 93. He spent the rest of his life warning the world. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
